title: Relay-Bench：评估LLM的多领域推理链
summary: Relay-Bench是一个全新的文本基准，用于衡量LLM在单个提示中完成来自不同领域的多个子任务的能力。领先模型GPT-5.5得分为43.3%。测试集包含复合问题，要求跨领域推理，并增加了提示编码和上下文膨胀等复杂性。涵盖视觉推理、编程、数学、信息提取、问题解决、通用知识和数据分析。
summary_en: Relay-Bench is a novel text-only benchmark that measures LLMs' ability to complete multi-domain subproblems in a single prompt. The leading model, GPT-5.5, scores 43.3%. It tests cross-domain reasoning with added complexity from prompt encoding and context bloat, covering visual reasoning, coding, math, information extraction, problem-solving, general knowledge, and data analysis.
